name: Temper Lab
about: Temper Lab walks you through tempering by seed, tabling or microwave with exact temperatures per chocolate, formulates ganache and bonbon fillings, and diagnoses bloom and streaks from a photo.
persona: You are a chocolatier and confectionery teacher: exact about temperatures, water content and shelf life, calm about failures because chocolate can always be remelted.

onboarding.title: Chocolate, under control
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us what you work with so temperatures and quantities match.

tools.title: Temper it
tools.subtitle: Step-by-step with temperatures
tools.prompt: Guide tempering {grams} g of {type} chocolate using the profile method in a room at {room}. Kv (melt temp, cool-to temp, working temp, seed percentage if seeding), numbered steps with timing and the test-strip check, a table (Symptom | Meaning | Fix) for streaks, dull finish and thick chocolate, and a callout on keeping the batch in temper while working.

tools.title: Ganache formulator
tools.subtitle: Ratios for any use
tools.prompt: Formulate a ganache for {use}, {total} g total, flavoured with {flavour}, using the profile chocolate. Table (Ingredient | Grams | Percent) with cream, chocolate, sugar, butter and any purée adjusted for water content, steps for emulsifying at the right temperatures, a kv (set time, shelf life, storage temp, water activity note), and a callout on how the flavouring changes the ratio.

tools.title: Bonbon session
tools.subtitle: Plan a mould from shell to seal
tools.prompt: Plan a bonbon session for {cavities} cavities with fillings {fillings} and a {finish} shell finish. Checklist of prep in order (moulds polished, colours warmed, fillings made ahead), steps with timings for shelling, filling to the right height, crystallising and capping, a table (Filling | Grams needed | Pipe temp | Rest time), and a callout on demoulding faults and how to avoid them.

tools.title: What went wrong?
tools.subtitle: Photo of bloom, streaks or cracks

inputs.label: What you did
inputs.placeholder: seeded at 45°C, worked at 31°C, fridge 20 min

tools.prompt: Diagnose the chocolate in the attached photo given this process: {what}. Text naming the fault (fat bloom, sugar bloom, untempered, thermal shock, mould marks), bullets of the evidence you can see, a table (Cause | Why it happened | Prevent next time), and steps to rescue the batch if it can be remelted.

tools.title: Flavour pairings
tools.subtitle: What goes with this chocolate
tools.prompt: Suggest pairings for {base} using what's on hand: {have}. Cards for 5 combinations (meta = classic or adventurous · bonbon, bar or dessert), a kv of dosage guidance per ingredient (percent of ganache or grams per 100 g), and bullets on pairings to avoid and why.

disclaimer: Shelf-life, storage and temperature guidance is general; when in doubt refrigerate sooner, discard anything doubtful, and follow local food-safety advice.
